Class UpdateAccessPolicyRequest

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.iam.model.json.creators.UpdateAccessPolicyRequest
public class UpdateAccessPolicyRequest extends Object
Request body for updating an IAM access policy via PUT /v1/projects/{projectId}/accessPolicies/{accessPolicyId} (operationId updateAccessPolicy, spec schema UpdateAccessPolicyBody).

The permissions, intersect and subtract fields carry the polymorphic UserRectSet/InlinePermission entries; each entry is a PolicyExpression that losslessly represents whichever oneOf form is supplied — a bare permission-set id / ERN string or a structured inline-permission / reference object. The lastRev field supports optimistic concurrency control.
